findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are embedded as plaintext environment variables in the Lambda function configuration. These secrets are committed to source control and exposed to anyone with read access to the Terraform configuration, state, or the deployed Lambda's environment variable settings, and the file's own comment confirms plaintext secrets are stored here.

The function uses runtime nodejs12.x, which is end-of-life and no longer receives security patches from AWS. Deploying on an unsupported runtime leaves the function exposed to known, unpatched vulnerabilities in Node.js and the Lambda execution environment.
